items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And we had Gus Muscapper and Robert Hall.

ctx.x: When you were about 12 years old, you have here on the sheet. A sheet of paper. What about August Roussel?

What about August Roussel? August Roussel used to play with us too. He was a tambour player. He was a good leader too, but sometimes he used to make mistakes and Lewis the Man, he used to get after him all the time, you know. I played with him about three years. But it wasn't his band, it was Lewis the Man's band. And we had Gus Muscapper and Robert Hall. You heard talking about Robert Hall? Edward Hall's brother. We had a line up like that. We had Henry Rush with us once. When he quit, we had Joe Stratton. You…
Slide whistle, you mean? Yeah. And Henry Rush was playing drums at the time?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Then I used to play with his brother, too. That's what I played at the country club. Which brother? That was Robert. Robert Hall.

ctx.x: That's the one, yeah. Whose band was it?

It was Eddie. Eddie Hall. We called him Edmund Hall. Edmund Hall. Then I used to play with his brother, too. That's what I played at the country club. Which brother? That was Robert. Robert Hall. Oh, yes. And he got another brother named Claren. I know him. And he got another brother. He got about four or five brothers. Herbert. Herbert is, one plays guitar, too. One plays a saxophone. All three of them play saxophone.
Herbert Hall is in New York now. Yeah. Herbert Hall, he's doing well, the other brother.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Ray Degas, Camilla Todd, and Robert Hall.

ctx.x: And then he had, let's see what I said, Camilla Todd too. Yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. He was in the Army with me. Yeah, yeah. Let's see now. Who was in Hippolyte, the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles? Who was in the band with Hippolyte Charles?
Ray Degas, Camilla Todd, and Robert Hall.

You got him, eh? Yeah, it's Zach. Zach and Clyde up. And Hippolyte is there and me. And, uh, Hippolyte is there and me. Let's see. Violin, nervous, and this one and this band. There's a player on that side, we used a player on that side. He always had two bands. Er, face. What's that guy named? Oakland? Oakland. Oakland. Oakland. Oakland. They used to play on that side, they used to play on that side. Always had two bands. Spring bass? What's that other man there? Oh man, Glinny, that's the guy? Glinny. Glinny.…
